mentions.text: BREAKING: South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix has filed with the SEC for a U.S. listing on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker SKHY.
BREAKING: SK Hynix, South Korea’s second-largest company by market value, will reportedly begin trading in the U.S. this Friday under the ticker $SKHY, per CNBC

NOTE FOR SK HYNIX TOMORROW

SK Hynix will begin trading tomorrow under the ticker SKHYV 

On Monday SK Hynix will switch over to its actual ticker $SKHY

I'm also hearing the leveraged single stock SK Hynix ETFs will begin trading on Tuesday

I believe that also means the options chain for SK Hynix will be launching on Wednesday of next week the earliest
SK Hynix will begin trading today under the temporary ticker $SKHYV before switching to its permanent ticker, $SKHY, on Monday.

Merry SK Hynix US IPO day to all that celebrate

Here's what to expect:

SK Hynix will begin trading today around the middle of the day. We don't have an exact time but generally its between 12PM ET - 1PM ET

SK Hynix will begin trading today under the stock ticker $SKHYV but it will trade under that ticker for JUST today

On Monday SK Hynix's ticker will switch to $SKHY which will then be its US stock ticker going forward

And then some more of the dates for the traders:

On Tuesday the leveraged and inverse ETFs should begin trading

- 2x Long SK Hynix = $SKHX
- 1x Short SK Hynix = $SKHZ
 
The SK Hynix options chain will then launch after that. The earliest I expect to see the SK options chain would be Wednesday but it could be later than that

Disclosure: This is just for informational purposes and not advice, Leverage Shares is a partner of the page. The single stock ETFs are made for traders who know what they are doing🫡
